limits: Finite gates do not establish a failure probability or universal correctness.
Baseline failures are preserved and never filtered out of paired timing statistics.
Intervals condition on the observed three key families; repeated pairs are not new families.
Input ciphertexts are checked for shape, hashes and pairing; their full GLWE plaintexts are not decrypted here.
Centering counts are independently derived; direct native verification is conditional on a centering field being emitted.
Native component hashes bind identical ordinary/Head/PFKS keys via frozen preparation; secret membership is not a formal proof.
Service bindings and wire acceptance/rejection are separate adoption gates.
